verses.zh: 当亚达薛西王年间，同我从巴比伦上来的人，他们的族长和他们的家谱记在下面：
verses.en: These are the leaders[NOTE:1] and those enrolled with them by genealogy who were coming up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
notes: Heb “the heads of their families.”

verses.zh: 属非尼哈的子孙有革顺；属以他玛的子孙有但以理；属大卫的子孙有哈突；
verses.en: from the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel; from the descendants of David, Hattush

verses.zh: 属巴录的后裔，就是示迦尼的子孙有撒迦利亚，同着他，按家谱计算，男丁一百五十人；
verses.en: the son of Shecaniah;[NOTE:1] from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were enrolled by genealogy 150 men;
notes: The MT reads here “from the sons of Shecaniah” with no descendant identified in what follows, contrary to the pattern of the context elsewhere. However, it seems better to understand the first phrase of v. 3 with the end of v. 2; the phrase would then modify the name “Hattush.” This understanding requires emending the reading מִבְּנֵי (mibbene, “from the sons of”) in the MT to בֵּן (ben, “[the] son of”). Cf. NAB, TEV, CEV, NLT.

verses.zh: 属巴哈・摩押的子孙有西拉希雅的儿子以利约乃，同着他有男丁二百；
verses.en: from the descendants of Pahath Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;

verses.zh: 属示迦尼的子孙有雅哈悉的儿子，同着他有男丁三百；
verses.en: from the descendants of Zattu,[NOTE:1] Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;
notes: The MT lacks “of Zattu.” The translation adopted above follows the LXX in including the words.

verses.zh: 属亚丁的子孙有约拿单的儿子以别，同着他有男丁五十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;

verses.zh: 属以拦的子孙有亚他利雅的儿子耶筛亚，同着他有男丁七十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

verses.zh: 属示法提雅的子孙有米迦勒的儿子西巴第雅，同着他有男丁八十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;

verses.zh: 属约押的子孙有耶歇的儿子俄巴底亚，同着他有男丁二百一十八；
verses.en: from the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;

verses.zh: 属示罗密的子孙有约细斐的儿子，同着他有男丁一百六十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Bani,[NOTE:1] Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;
notes: The MT lacks “Bani.” It is restored on the basis of certain LXX MSS.

verses.zh: 属比拜的子孙有比拜的儿子撒迦利亚，同着他有男丁二十八；
verses.en: from the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;

verses.zh: 属押甲的子孙有哈加坦的儿子约哈难，同着他有男丁一百一十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;

verses.zh: 属亚多尼干的子孙，就是末尾的，他们的名字是以利法列、耶利、示玛雅，同着他们有男丁六十；
verses.en: from the descendants of Adonikam there were the latter ones.[NOTE:1] Their names were Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;
notes: Or “those who came later.” The exact meaning of this Hebrew phrase is uncertain. It may refer to the last remaining members of Adonikam’s family who were in Babylon. So, for example, H. G. M. Williamson, Ezra, Nehemiah (WBC), 108; cf. NASB, NIV, NCV. The phrase has also been taken to mean “the younger sons (so NAB), or the ones who “returned at a later date” (so TEV).

verses.zh: 属比革瓦伊的子孙有乌太和撒布，同着他们有男丁七十。
verses.en: from the descendants of Bigvai, Uthai, and Zaccur,[NOTE:1] and with them[NOTE:2] 70 men.
notes: The translation reads with the Qere, the Lucianic Greek recension, the Syriac Peshitta, and the Vulgate וְזַּכּוּר (vezakkur, “and Zaccur”) rather than the Kethib of the MT, וְזַבוּד (vezavud, “and Zabbud”).

The MT has “with him” (so NAB). The present translation (“with them”) is based on the reading of many medieval Hebrew MSS, the Lucianic Greek recension, the Syriac Peshitta, and the Vulgate (so also KJV, NASB, NIV, NRSV).

verses.zh: 我招聚这些人在流入亚哈瓦的河边，我们在那里住了三日。我查看百姓和祭司，见没有利未人在那里，
verses.en: I had them assemble[NOTE:1] at the canal[NOTE:2] that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there for three days. I observed that the people and the priests were present, but I found no Levites there.
notes: Or “I gathered them.”
Heb “river.” So also in vv. 21, 31.

verses.zh: 就召首领以利以谢、亚列、示玛雅、以利拿单、雅立、以利拿单、拿单、撒迦利亚、米书兰，又召教习约雅立和以利拿单。
verses.en: So I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan,[NOTE:1] Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, who were leaders, and Joiarib and Elnathan, who were teachers.
notes: The name “Elnathan” occurs twice in this list. Some, assuming an accidental repetition, would include it only once (cf. NAB).

verses.zh: 我打发他们往迦西斐雅地方去见那里的首领易多，又告诉他们当向易多和他的弟兄尼提宁说甚么话，叫他们为我们　神的殿带使用的人来。
verses.en: I sent them to Iddo, who was the leader in the place called Casiphia. I told them[NOTE:1] what to say to Iddo and his relatives,[NOTE:2] who were the temple servants in[NOTE:3] Casiphia, so they would bring us attendants for the temple of our God.
notes: Heb “I placed in their mouth words.”
The translation reads with the LXX and Vulgate וְאֶחָיו (veʾekhayv, “and his brethren” = “relatives”; so NCV, NLT) rather than the reading אָחִיו (ʾakhiv, “his brother”) of the MT.
Heb “in the place called.” This phrase has not been repeated in the translation for stylistic reasons.

verses.zh: 蒙我们　神施恩的手帮助我们，他们在以色列的曾孙、利未的孙子、抹利的后裔中带一个通达人来；还有示利比和他的众子与弟兄共一十八人。
verses.en: Due to the fact that the good hand of our God was on us, they brought us a skilled man, from the descendants of Mahli the son of Levi son of Israel. This man was Sherebiah,[NOTE:1] who was accompanied by his sons and brothers,[NOTE:2] 18 men;
notes: Heb “and Sherebiah.” The words “this man was” are not in the Hebrew text, but have been supplied in the translation for clarity and for stylistic reasons.
Or “relatives” (so CEV; NRSV “kin”); also in v. 19.

verses.zh: 又有哈沙比雅，同着他有米拉利的子孙耶筛亚，并他的众子和弟兄共二十人。
verses.en: and Hashabiah, along with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, with his brothers and their sons, 20 men;

verses.zh: 从前大卫和众首领派尼提宁服事利未人，现在从这尼提宁中也带了二百二十人来，都是按名指定的。
verses.en: and some of the temple servants that David and his officials had established for the work of the Levites—220 of them. They were all designated by name.

verses.zh: 那时，我在亚哈瓦河边宣告禁食，为要在我们　神面前克苦己心，求他使我们和妇人孩子，并一切所有的，都得平坦的道路。
verses.en: I called for a fast there by the Ahava Canal, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and seek from him a safe journey[NOTE:1] for us, our children, and all our property.
notes: Heb “a straight way.”

verses.zh: 我求王拨步兵马兵帮助我们抵挡路上的仇敌，本以为羞耻；因我曾对王说：「我们　神施恩的手必帮助一切寻求他的；但他的能力和忿怒必攻击一切离弃他的。」
verses.en: I was embarrassed to request soldiers and horsemen from the king to protect us from the enemy[NOTE:1] along the way, because we had said to the king, “The good hand of our God is on everyone who is seeking him, but his great anger[NOTE:2] is against everyone who forsakes him.”
notes: A number of modern translations regard this as a collective singular and translate “from enemies” (also in v. 31).
Heb “his strength and his anger.” The expression is a hendiadys (one concept expressed through two terms).

verses.zh: 所以我们禁食祈求我们的　神，他就应允了我们。
verses.en: So we fasted and prayed to our God about this, and he answered us.

verses.zh: 我分派祭司长十二人，就是示利比、哈沙比雅，和他们的弟兄十人，
verses.en: Then I set apart 12 of the leading priests, together with[NOTE:1] Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and 10 of their brothers,[NOTE:2]
notes: The translation reads וְשֵׁרֵבְיָה וַחֲשַׁבְיָה (veshereveyah vakhashavyah, “and Sherebiah and Hashabiah”) rather than the reading לְשֵׁרֵבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָה (leshereveyah khashavyah, “to Sherebiah Hashabiah”) of the MT.
Or “relatives”; or “colleagues” (cf. NLT “ten other priests”).

verses.zh: 将王和谋士、军长，并在那里的以色列众人为我们　神殿所献的金银和器皿，都秤了交给他们。
verses.en: and I weighed out to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels intended for the temple of our God—items that the king, his advisers, his officials, and all Israel who were present had contributed.

verses.zh: 我秤了交在他们手中的银子有六百五十他连得；银器重一百他连得；金子一百他连得；
verses.en: I weighed out to them:[NOTE:1] 650 talents of silver, silver vessels worth 100 talents,[NOTE:2] 100 talents of gold,
notes: Heb “upon their hand.”
Possibly “100 silver vessels worth [?] talents” or “silver vessels weighing 100 talents.”

verses.zh: 金碗二十个，重一千达利克；上等光铜的器皿两个，宝贵如金。
verses.en: 20 gold bowls worth 1,000 darics, and 2 exquisite vessels of gleaming bronze, as valuable as gold.

verses.zh: 我对他们说：「你们归耶和华为圣，器皿也为圣；金银是甘心献给耶和华―你们列祖之　神的。
verses.en: Then I said to them, “You are holy to the Lord, just as these vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a voluntary offering to the Lord, the God of your fathers.

verses.zh: 你们当警醒看守，直到你们在耶路撒冷耶和华殿的库内，在祭司长和利未族长，并以色列的各族长面前过了秤。」
verses.en: Be careful with them and protect them, until you weigh them out before the leading priests and the Levites and the family leaders of Israel in Jerusalem,[NOTE:1] in the storerooms of the temple of the Lord.
notes: For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.

verses.zh: 于是，祭司、利未人按着分量接受金银和器皿，要带到耶路撒冷我们　神的殿里。
verses.en: Then the priests and the Levites took charge of[NOTE:1] the silver, the gold, and the vessels that had been weighed out, to transport them to Jerusalem to the temple of our God.
notes: Heb “received.”

verses.zh: 正月十二日，我们从亚哈瓦河边起行，要往耶路撒冷去。我们　神的手保佑我们，救我们脱离仇敌和路上埋伏之人的手。
verses.en: On the twelfth day of the first month we began traveling from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from our enemies and from bandits[NOTE:1] along the way.
notes: Heb “from the hand of the enemy and the one who lies in wait.” Some modern English versions render the latter phrase as “ambushes” (cf. NASB, NRSV).

verses.zh: 我们到了耶路撒冷，在那里住了三日。
verses.en: So we came to Jerusalem, and we stayed there for three days.

verses.zh: 第四日，在我们　神的殿里把金银和器皿都秤了，交在祭司乌利亚的儿子米利末的手中。同着他有非尼哈的儿子以利亚撒，还有利未人耶书亚的儿子约撒拔和宾内的儿子挪亚底。
verses.en: On the fourth day we weighed out the silver, the gold, and the vessels in the house of our God into the care[NOTE:1] of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest, and Eleazar son of Phinehas, who were accompanied by Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui, who were Levites.
notes: Heb “upon the hand of.”

verses.zh: 当时都点了数目，按着分量写在册上。
verses.en: Everything was verified[NOTE:1] by number and by weight, and the total weight was written down at that time.
notes: The words “was verified” are not in the Hebrew text but have been supplied in the translation for clarity.

verses.zh: 从掳到之地归回的人向以色列的　神献燔祭，就是为以色列众人献公牛十二只，公绵羊九十六只，绵羊羔七十七只，又献公山羊十二只作赎罪祭，这都是向耶和华焚献的。
verses.en: The exiles who were returning from the captivity offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel—12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 male lambs, along with 12 male goats as a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord.

verses.zh: 他们将王的谕旨交给王所派的总督与河西的省长，他们就帮助百姓，又供给　神殿里所需用的。
verses.en: Then they presented the decrees of the king to the king’s satraps and to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, who assisted the people and the temple of God.
